$comment: How a Corvus 7300-series part number is put together.
Transcribed from the guidance supplied 21 August 2026: "HOW TO INTERPRET CORVUS
7300-SERIES PART NUMBERS". Every code, label and compatibility note below is from
The same positional grammar runs the 6400 series, which is how the reading was
checked before anything was built: all 947 CIJ part numbers in the catalogue
decode against it, and their descriptions agree at every position. Z167N714HJU is
"6400 2M PH4 Standard" — model 890, head U, length 0 — and H922H657DPG is "6440 IP65
SPEC PH4 MIDI+ 2M", which confirms both that 6 means Prism and that D is the
Standard Plus for Prism. The length codes are confirmed the same way: 1 is 2M90D,
3 is 4M90D, 7 is 6M90D, and 90D is the right angle.
WHAT IS NOT HERE. The 6400 series is not modelled as a configurator, because two
of its positions are not settled by this sheet: it uses 43 specific ink codes
rather than the 7300's five ink categories, and it has a suffix position (SSC or
HPC) that the 7300 does not — 38 of those 43 ink codes appear with both suffixes,
so the suffix is an independent choice and not something derivable. Guessing at
either would put a part number that cannot be ordered onto a quote.
NO PRICE. No price page carries the 7300 series, so this composes a part number
and says what it means; it cannot cost one. See announced-machines.json.

positions.label: Ink category
positions.note: A category, not one ink. The ink itself is chosen during commissioning — refer to the Ink Guide.

options.label: 1121 UV-readable
options.why: For PH4 Standard or PH4 Compact. Uses an alternative pressure transducer.

options.label: Other dye-based inks
options.why: Use with PH4 Standard; some also support PH4 Standard Plus or Compact. Choose the dye ink during commissioning.

options.label: Soft-pigmented: 1009, 1033, 1079, 1088
options.why: Requires PH4 Standard Plus. Choose the ink during commissioning.

options.label: Hard-pigmented: 1043, 1053, 1059, 1069, 1306, 1311, 1320
options.why: Requires Prism plus PH4 Standard Plus for Prism. Choose during commissioning.
